remarks: Tucked away in a desirable section of Sugarloaf, this charming single-story Sierra-style cabin offers the kind of mountain getaway that makes it easy to leave the busy world behind. With 2 bedrooms and 1 bath, the home features vaulted tongue-and-groove ceilings that bring warmth, character, and that classic Big Bear cabin feel. What really sets this property apart is the spacious, level triple lot totaling 7,500 square feet—a rare find with plenty of room to enjoy the outdoors, entertain, or simply relax among the pines.
